title: IELTS G类阅读长难句训练题库

items.sentence: They are installed to detect the presence of smoke and emit a clear sound to alert you in the event of fire.

roles.subject: They
roles.object: to detect the presence of smoke and emit a clear sound
roles.scope: in the event of fire

items.explanation: 主句是被动结构 They are installed，后面的 to 短语说明安装目的。
items.simplified_zh: 它们被安装，用来探测烟雾并在火灾时发出警报。
items.answer_impact: 看到 to 不要自动当主句谓语；它经常用于说明目的。

items.sentence: Ionization alarms are the cheapest and most readily available smoke alarms.

roles.subject: Ionization alarms
roles.object: the cheapest and most readily available smoke alarms

items.explanation: 这是主系表结构，are 后面是表语，不需要强行寻找动作宾语。
items.simplified_zh: 电离式报警器最便宜，也最容易买到。
items.answer_impact: 两个最高级都属于核心结论。

items.sentence: They will detect flaming fires before the smoke gets too thick.

roles.subject: They
roles.scope: before the smoke gets too thick

items.explanation: before 引出时间边界，说明探测发生在烟雾过浓之前。
items.simplified_zh: 它们会在烟雾太浓之前探测到明火。
items.answer_impact: before 和 after 方向看反会直接导致判断错误。

items.sentence: However, photoelectric alarms are more effective at detecting slow-burning fires.

roles.subject: photoelectric alarms
roles.object: more effective at detecting slow-burning fires

items.explanation: However 表示与前文电离式报警器形成转折对比。
items.simplified_zh: 但是，光电式报警器更擅长探测慢燃火灾。
items.answer_impact: 转折后的信息通常是命题重点。

items.sentence: They are less likely to go off accidentally and so are best for homes with one floor.

roles.subject: They
roles.predicate: are less likely to go off accidentally
roles.object: best for homes with one floor
roles.scope: homes with one floor

items.explanation: and so 表示前因后果：较少误报，因此适合单层住宅。
items.simplified_zh: 它们较少误报，所以最适合单层住宅。
items.answer_impact: 不能把单层住宅扩大成所有住宅。

items.sentence: Most battery-powered smoke alarms can be installed by the home owner and do not require professional installation.

roles.subject: Most battery-powered smoke alarms
roles.scope: Most battery-powered smoke alarms

items.explanation: Most 限定范围；can be installed 与 do not require 是并列信息。
items.simplified_zh: 大多数电池报警器可由房主安装，也不需要专业安装。
items.answer_impact: 原文没有说明安装时长，不能推出安装很快。

items.sentence: For the installation of hard-wired smoke alarms, however, you will need the services of a licensed professional.

roles.subject: you
roles.object: the services of a licensed professional
roles.scope: For the installation of hard-wired smoke alarms

items.explanation: however 把硬接线报警器与前面的电池报警器区分开；真正主语是 you。
items.simplified_zh: 但是，安装硬接线报警器需要持证专业人士。
items.answer_impact: licensed professional 可被改写为 specialist technician。

items.sentence: Photoelectric smoke alarms in any quantity may be disposed of in domestic waste.

roles.subject: Photoelectric smoke alarms
roles.scope: in any quantity

items.explanation: in any quantity 限定的是光电式报警器，不能套到电离式报警器。
items.simplified_zh: 任何数量的光电报警器都可作为家庭垃圾处理。
items.answer_impact: 对象和范围必须一起保留。

items.sentence: If you have fewer than ten ionization alarms to get rid of, you may put them in your domestic waste.

roles.subject: you
roles.scope: If you have fewer than ten ionization alarms to get rid of

items.explanation: If 从句给出条件，主句中的 may 表示允许而不是必须。
items.simplified_zh: 少于十个电离式报警器时，可以放进家庭垃圾。
items.answer_impact: 题干若说任何数量都要联系市政，就是扩大范围。

items.sentence: If you have more than ten to dispose of, you should contact your local council.

roles.subject: you
roles.scope: If you have more than ten to dispose of

items.explanation: 只有 more than ten 这个条件成立时，才应联系市政。
items.simplified_zh: 超过十个时，应联系当地市政。
items.answer_impact: fewer than ten 与 more than ten 是相反边界。

items.sentence: Your battery-powered smoke alarm will produce a short beep every 60 seconds to alert you when the battery is running out.

roles.subject: Your battery-powered smoke alarm
roles.scope: when the battery is running out

items.explanation: 主干是 alarm will produce a beep；to alert 表示目的，when 表示触发时间。
items.simplified_zh: 电量不足时，报警器会定时发出蜂鸣提醒你。
items.answer_impact: warning sound 和 battery power is low 是同义改写。

items.sentence: Nevertheless, it should be tested every month to ensure that the battery and the alarm sounder are working.

roles.subject: it
roles.scope: to ensure that the battery and the alarm sounder are working

items.explanation: Nevertheless 表示让步；should be tested 是被动谓语，to ensure 是目的。
items.simplified_zh: 尽管如此，它仍应每月测试一次。
items.answer_impact: every month 不等于每月多次。

items.sentence: Using interactive audio-visual technology, your guide will take you on a memorable journey inside the building.

roles.subject: your guide
roles.object: you on a memorable journey inside the building
roles.scope: Using interactive audio-visual technology

items.explanation: 句首 Using 短语是方式状语，主语不是 technology，而是 your guide。
items.simplified_zh: 导游会利用互动视听技术带你参观建筑内部。
items.answer_impact: 句首分词短语容易让人误认主语。

items.sentence: Not only can you enjoy the best views in Sydney, you can claim a 20% reduction on the total cost of your meal.

roles.subject: you
roles.object: a 20% reduction on the total cost of your meal
roles.scope: Not only can you enjoy the best views in Sydney

items.explanation: Not only 放句首造成倒装，后半句继续补充第二项福利。
items.simplified_zh: 你不仅能看景色，还能享受餐费八折。
items.answer_impact: not only 结构不能只保留一项。

items.sentence: Do not forget to show your ticket in order to claim your discount.

roles.subject: you
roles.scope: in order to claim your discount

items.explanation: 祈使句省略主语 you；in order to 表示出示门票的目的。
items.simplified_zh: 别忘记出示门票，才能领取折扣。
items.answer_impact: 优惠存在附加条件，并非自动获得。

items.sentence: Prior bookings are not essential.
items.explanation: not essential 表示不必要，不等于不允许预订。
items.simplified_zh: 提前预订不是必需的。
items.answer_impact: 需要看清否定作用范围。

items.sentence: The tour concludes with a complimentary breakfast in the Green Room.

roles.subject: The tour
roles.object: with a complimentary breakfast in the Green Room

items.explanation: concludes with 表示活动最后以什么结束。
items.simplified_zh: 游览最后以绿厅免费早餐结束。
items.answer_impact: concludes 对应流程最后一步。

items.sentence: For safety reasons, children aged twelve and under are not permitted.

roles.subject: children aged twelve and under
roles.scope: aged twelve and under

items.explanation: For safety reasons 给出原因，aged twelve and under 限定被禁止的人群。
items.simplified_zh: 出于安全原因，十二岁及以下儿童不得参加。
items.answer_impact: 年龄范围和否定都必须保留。

items.sentence: Employees who operate heavy machinery are required to attend the safety course.

roles.subject: Employees
roles.scope: who operate heavy machinery

items.explanation: who 从句只限定操作重型机械的员工，主句谓语是 are required。
items.simplified_zh: 操作重型机械的员工必须参加安全课程。
items.answer_impact: 不能扩大成所有员工。

items.sentence: Although the course is free, participants are responsible for the cost of materials.

roles.subject: participants
roles.scope: Although the course is free

items.explanation: Although 引出让步，真正需要注意的是主句中的材料费责任。
items.simplified_zh: 课程免费，但材料费由参加者承担。
items.answer_impact: free 不等于完全没有费用。

items.sentence: Unless payment is received by Monday, the reservation will be cancelled.

roles.subject: the reservation
roles.scope: Unless payment is received by Monday

items.explanation: unless 等于如果不，条件未满足时才发生取消结果。
items.simplified_zh: 如果周一前未收到付款，预订会被取消。
items.answer_impact: 不要把 unless 当成普通 if。

items.sentence: Applicants will be contacted once all interviews have been completed.

roles.subject: Applicants
roles.scope: once all interviews have been completed

items.explanation: once 在这里表示当全部面试完成之后，不是一次。
items.simplified_zh: 全部面试完成后才联系申请者。
items.answer_impact: 先后顺序是答案的一部分。

items.sentence: Additional staff have been employed to reduce waiting times.

roles.subject: Additional staff
roles.scope: to reduce waiting times

items.explanation: have been employed 是被动谓语，to reduce 表示目的。
items.simplified_zh: 增聘员工是为了缩短等待时间。
items.answer_impact: 不要把目的误当成已经实现的结果。

items.sentence: Full-time employees receive paid leave, whereas temporary workers are not entitled to this benefit.

roles.subject: Full-time employees
roles.scope: whereas temporary workers are not entitled to this benefit

items.explanation: whereas 对比两类员工的不同待遇。
items.simplified_zh: 正式员工有带薪假，临时员工没有。
items.answer_impact: 比较对象不能互换。

items.sentence: Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.

roles.subject: Applications
roles.scope: received after the closing date

items.explanation: received after the closing date 是后置修饰，主干谓语是 will not be considered。
items.simplified_zh: 截止日期后收到的申请不会被考虑。
items.answer_impact: 忽略后置修饰会误解成所有申请。

items.sentence: Employees may work from home provided that their manager has approved the arrangement.

roles.subject: Employees
roles.scope: provided that their manager has approved the arrangement

items.explanation: provided that 表示前提条件，may 只表示允许。
items.simplified_zh: 经理批准后，员工才可以居家办公。
items.answer_impact: 居家办公不是无条件权利。

items.sentence: Visitors wishing to enter the restricted area must obtain written permission from the site manager.

roles.subject: Visitors
roles.object: written permission from the site manager
roles.scope: wishing to enter the restricted area

items.explanation: wishing to enter the restricted area 限定 Visitors；must obtain 是核心谓语。
items.simplified_zh: 想进入限制区域的访客必须取得书面许可。
items.answer_impact: 规定只针对特定访客。

items.sentence: The role involves answering customer enquiries as well as preparing weekly reports.

roles.subject: The role
roles.object: answering customer enquiries as well as preparing weekly reports

items.explanation: as well as 连接两项职责，两项都属于 involves 的内容。
items.simplified_zh: 这个岗位既要回复客户咨询，也要准备周报。
items.answer_impact: 不能只选其中一项职责。

items.sentence: Applicants should submit either a passport or a driving licence.

roles.subject: Applicants
roles.object: either a passport or a driving licence

items.explanation: either or 表示二选一，不是两项都提交。
items.simplified_zh: 申请者应提交护照或驾照其中一种。
items.answer_impact: 选择关系决定所需材料数量。

items.sentence: Staff are normally expected to attend the office, but those whose work can be completed remotely may apply to work from home.

roles.subject: Staff
roles.scope: those whose work can be completed remotely

items.explanation: but 后面给出例外人群；may apply 表示可以申请，不是自动获准。
items.simplified_zh: 通常要到办公室，但适合远程工作的人可申请居家办公。
items.answer_impact: 通常规则、例外范围和允许程度都不能丢。
